stemMarkdown: How many students play cricket only?
solutionMarkdown:
Strip the overlaps out of the cricket total, then restore the triple region that has now been removed twice:

$70 - 30 - 20 + 10 = 30$

**30 students**. Filling the Venn diagram from the centre outwards is the safer habit: 10 in the middle, then $30 - 10 = 20$ in cricket-and-football only, $20 - 10 = 10$ in cricket-and-tennis only, and $70 - 10 - 20 - 10 = 30$ left in cricket alone.
